title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
abstract: arXiv:2610.19095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chatbot Arena ranks language models with the Bradley-Terry model, which gives each model one score and so assumes Luce's choice axiom. Choice theory predicts where this fails: near-copies are told apart more decisively than their scores imply. On 1.8 million Arena votes, votes between versions of one model are 1.37 times as decisive as Bradley-Terry predicts, between sizes of one generation 1.26 times and between models of one lab 1.12 times; a release a year later gives consistent multipliers, and the effect survives alternative tie treatments, prompt subsets and topics, and timing checks. How alike two models' answers are worded and formatted tracks the effect. translated_title: 相似的模型，失灵的胜率：Luce公理在Chatbot竞技场中的失效之处
translated_abstract: Chatbot竞技场使用Bradley-Terry模型对语言模型进行排名，该模型为每个模型赋予单一分数，因而隐含地假设了Luce选择公理。选择理论预言了该公理会在何处失效：近似复制的模型被区分的果断程度会超出其分数所暗示的水平。基于180万条竞技场投票数据，同一模型不同版本之间的投票果断程度是Bradley-Terry预测的1.37倍，同一代不同参数规模之间为1.26倍，同一实验室不同模型之间为1.12倍；一年后的新发布模型也呈现出一致的乘数，且该效应在替代性的平局处理方式、提示词子集与主题划分以及时间检验下依然稳健。两个模型回答在措辞和格式上的相似程度能够追踪这一效应。一个仅含四到六个参数的修正模型在预测留出集投票方面优于Bradley-Terry模型以及拥有数百个参数的模型，这主要归功于对平局的建模；在预先设定的测试中，将该修正模型冻结并应用于新发布的模型时，其收益集中于平局情形，并在成对比较中表现更优。
tldr: 该研究发现Chatbot Arena所依赖的Bradley-Terry模型（即Luce选择公理）在高度相似的模型之间会系统性失效——相似模型间的对决比分数预测的更具决定性（最高达1.37倍），并提出一个仅含4-6个参数、主要通过建模平局的修正方法，其预测能力超越了Bradley-Terry及含数百参数的复杂模型。
en_tdlr: The study shows that the Bradley-Terry model underlying Chatbot Arena (which assumes Luce's choice axiom) systematically fails between highly similar models—near-copies are judged 1.12–1.37 times more decisively than predicted—and a simple 4–6 parameter correction, mostly by modeling ties, outperforms both Bradley-Terry and models with hundreds of parameters.
